notes: v571 — the background grading now TELLS you what it's doing, and heals itself. Until now, if the automatic grading failed once at load, the radar read ‘not proven’ for every share for the rest of the session with nothing on screen to explain it — indistinguishable from ‘still working’. Now the ⚖ EVIDENCE line says ⏳ ‘grading N shares in the background…’ while it runs, and if it can't reach the server it says so and RETRIES automatically after 30 seconds. If it still fails, opening the 📋 report card forces a fresh attempt. Nothing about the grading maths changed. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
